title: Precision prevention of colorectal neoplasia in patients undergoing hemorrhoid surgery: an explainable machine learning model for identifying the risk of precancerous neoplastic polyps.
summary: An explainable model identified precancerous-polyp risk among patients undergoing hemorrhoid surgery.
ai_technology: Random Forest and six comparator machine-learning models
organization: Wujin Hospital Affiliated with Jiangsu University

evidence.tested: The models used a training/test split with grid-search cross-validation; Random Forest had test-set AUROC 0.738 after training AUROC 0.892, while SHAP ranked age highest among reported predictors.
evidence.unknown: The reported evaluation does not establish prospective benefit or performance beyond the studied setting.
evidence.ai_role: Estimates precancerous-neoplastic-polyp risk after hemorrhoid surgery; SHAP describes the Random Forest model’s predictor contributions.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
